events.title: Sustainable Saturdays
events.description:
Join us for Sustainable Saturdays in partnership with Niagara Cares. Families can create art using recycled materials while exploring fun ways to reuse everyday items. Together, we’ll learn how small changes can help care for our community and the environment.
Included in museum admission. Space is limited! Book your tickets now.
*Members do not require a reservation.
*Events and dates are subject to change.
About the play partner: 
Niagara Cares is the heart of what we do and who we are at Niagara Bottling. For more than 60 years, we have been making a difference for our Team Members, consumers and communities through philanthropic giving, volunteering, water donations, and disaster relief. As a family-owned business, we are committed to creating meaningful change for our communities through a spirit of giving back both big and small. For more information, visitniagarawater.com/niagara-cares.
Frequently Asked Questions:
Is Sustainable Saturdays included with museum admission?
Yes. All Sustainable Saturdays activities are included with regular museum admission. 
When does Sustainable Saturdays take place?
Sustainable Saturdays is held on the fourth Saturday of every month in the Art Studio.

events.title: Artists in Action with Chuck Jones
events.display_title: Artists in Action with Chuck Jones
events.description:
Artists in Action with Chuck Jones Center for Creativity invites families to explore creativity together through hands-on experiences led by real artists. Each visit offers new materials, fresh ideas, and playful ways for children to express themselves and connect through art.
Times: 11am-12pm 
About the play partner: 
Founded upon the time-honored philosophies of legendary, Oscar-winning animation director Chuck Jones, the Chuck Jones Center for Creativity is a 501c3 charity dedicated to stimulating innovative thinking, individual expression and interpersonal collaboration – on its mission to nurture creative solutions to some of society’s most urgent and unmet needs. Our programs for youth (including those on the autism spectrum), adults of all ages, schools, businesses and organizational teams focus on elevating, celebrating and accelerating the creative genius in all of us, all for the betterment of the individuals, the groups and the communities we serve.
Frequently Asked Questions 
Is this program included with museum admission?
Yes. Artists in Action is included with regular museum admission. 
What ages is this program best for?
This experience is designed for children ages 0–8 and their families. 
Is this a structured class?
No. This is a drop-in, open-ended creative experience where families can participate at their own pace. 
When should we arrive?
Families can drop in anytime between 11:00 am and 1:45 pm. 
Will materials be provided?
Yes. All materials are provided as part of the experience. 
Will Chuck Jones Center for Creativity be back?
Yes. The Chuck Jones Center for Creativity will return for additional sessions on August 22. 
Who is Chuck Jones?
Chuck Jones was a legendary, Oscar-winning animation director best known for creating and directing beloved characters like Bugs Bunny, Daffy Duck, and the Road Runner. His legacy continues through the Chuck Jones Center for Creativity, which inspires people of all ages to explore creativity and innovation. 
*Please note programming lasts 10-30 minutes. 
Included with museum admission 
Books will be available for purchase during the event.
Space may be limited. 
*Events and times are subject to change.

events.title: Meet the Author with Griselda Maldonado
events.display_title: Meet the Author with Griselda Maldonado
events.description:
Storytime and Meet the Author with Griselda Maldonado!
TIMES: 11 am ONLY
About the play partner: 
Dr. Griselda Maldonado is a Santa Ana native, educator, and bilingual author who celebrates culture through storytelling. Inspired by her family’s journey, she is dedicated to preserving language and tradition for future generations. 
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/drgriseldaauthor/?hl=en 
Linkedln: https://www.linkedin.com/in/griselda-maldonado-ed-d-ab1879306/ 
X: https://x.com/drgrismaldonado 
 
Book Bio: This heartwarming bilingual children’s book follows Abuelita as she lovingly prepares a variety of traditional Mexican dishes in her kitchen. As she cooks, young readers are introduced to numbers one through ten, vibrant vegetables, rich colors, and cultural foods found in the mercado and at family gatherings. Through rhythmic, repetitive text in English and Spanish, the story celebrates language, family traditions, and the joy of cooking together. It invites children to count, learn new vocabulary, and connect with their heritage while honoring the warmth and love of an abuelita’s kitchen.

events.title: Celebrating Obon
events.description:
Join us as we celebrate Obon, a meaningful Japanese tradition that honors and remembers ancestors through dance, storytelling, and community. Families are invited to learn about themes of remembrance, gratitude, and connection! 
Times: 11am & 2:30pm
Activities and times subject to change. 
About the play partner: Orange County Buddhist Church (OCBC) 
The Orange County Buddhist Church (OCBC) is a Jōdo Shinshū (Shin Buddhist) temple located in Anaheim, California, and a member of the Buddhist Churches of America’s (BCA) Southern District. Originally established to serve the Japanese American community, OCBC has grown into a vibrant center of Shin Buddhist life in Southern California. The church achieved independent status in 1965 and has been serving the greater Orange County region for over six decades. 
OCBC is affiliated with the Jōdo Shinshū Hongwanji-ha tradition, whose head temple (Nishi Honganji) is located in Kyoto, Japan.
